reuse.why: Keeps every expected-amount decision in the existing getExpectedScheduleAmount and exposes it through the API model, but writes the 7.5% tolerance inline instead of calling the existing getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules.

duplication.why: `Math.round(Math.abs(amount) * 0.075)` duplicates getApproxNumberThreshold, the tolerance used by rule matching, so the two can drift apart.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts and the API field is computed in the existing scheduleModel mapper in api-models.ts.

scope.why: Only the amount rule, its callers, the API field, comments and tests change.

maintainability.why: The optional `op` parameter lets callers silently skip the approximate rule: the forecast (forecast-schedules.ts) and the new API expectedAmount call without it, so approximate schedules resolve differently there than in posting, previews and action syncing.

bypasses_abstraction.where: shared/schedules.ts getExpectedScheduleAmount computes the approximate tolerance itself rather than using getApproxNumberThreshold in shared/rules.ts.

disguised_duplication.where: The tolerance formula is copied verbatim inline, not disguised.

abstraction_drift.where: getExpectedScheduleAmount gains an optional `op` and an `isapprox` branch; server/forecast/forecast-schedules.ts and server/api-models.ts scheduleModel call it without the op, so they do not apply the approximate rule.
